```python
temp = "hello=good="

# Split only at the first '=' so that the rest of the string (including any trailing '=') stays together
parts = temp.split('=', 1)

print(parts)          # → ['hello', 'good=']

# If you prefer unpacking:
key, value = temp.split('=', 1)
print(key, value)     # → hello good=
```

Using `split('=', 1)` limits the split to a single occurrence, giving you exactly `["hello", "good="]`.
